notes.title: 🧙 EA UPDATE 12 - THE ASTRAL RIFTLANDS
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/c34e6f6dfa11c032eae1ac423a419fbde96604e5.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s been some time but we’re back! With Gamescom and some well-deserved vacations behind us, we’ve been going full force for the past month to bring you our 12th Update![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌎New Realm[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/88c8cb2430ff7b868082e9b4ddd240c3ec5f0975.gif"][/img][/p][p]This realm is known as the [b]Astral Riftlands[/b]. Once a magical haven, but extensive spellcasting reduced it to a chaotic mess full of new dangers…[/p][p][/p][h3][b]💀New Enemies[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/97f13f679c5e37418ecb12cee14d45032236b8eb.gif"][/img][/p][p]Some of those dangers you’ll be facing:[/p][list][*][p][b]Void Hoppers[/b]: groups of weird bouncy creatures that will ambush you from above[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rift Sentinels[/b]: turret-like appendages that stay in place to shoot at you[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stinky Crabs[/b]: mutated Flesh Crabs that explode on death, leaving behind a damaging cloud[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎯New Objective[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/24883bd720346cf55baab904ec188e3695bb065d.gif"][/img][/p][p]A new side objective has also been added to the pool. If encountered, players must try to light a set of braziers in a specific order. If all braziers are lit before the time is up, each player will get a new spell augmentation.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]☝️Solitary Focus[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/307a00704f2113919b2da91a57722ef3ee704fd0.gif"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]We've also made some changes to the Solitary Focus Covenant. Now, each player can choose for themselves to enable/disable the Covenant (if they’ve unlocked it of course). Matchmaking will still prioritize players with the same configuration as yours, but you’ll no longer be bound to the choice of the team leader.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]💪Spell Transparency[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/8740f5e15b1f624d7ed4fca94d9ca76cbc9c744b.gif"][/img]  [/p][p]One of our most requested features (aside from a new world) was being able to set the transparency of your spells. You can now access this setting in the Video Options, labeled as [b]Spell Visibility[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]PATCH NOTES – 0.12.0.5763 (24-09-25)[/b][/h2][h3][b]✨NEW[/b][/h3][list][*][p]📢 A new Dev: [b]Maria[/b] - Marketing Lead[/p][/*][*][p]🌎 A new Realm: [b]the Astral Riftlands[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]💀 [/b]3 new Enemies: [b]Void Hopper[/b], [b]Rift Sentinel [/b]& [b]Stinky Crab[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🎯 [/b]A new Objective: [b]Light the Braziers[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🏆 [/b]4 new Quests[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🕹️GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✅ Made the Solitary Focus Covenant configurable by player, meaning each player can choose for themselves to enable/disable it when in a party.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved Krog’wa’s navigation so she moves towards players faster when far away.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved the colliders of Crablings and Tripods (minion enemies).[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved despawning when enemies are off-screen for too long.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Updated the colliders in the Pyrestorm Pit to remove some exploitable areas.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Improved the way the Size stat is calculated to make it more impactful.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved the Level Up Menu so all Spells relevant to a specific upgrade are now properly highlighted.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved the order in which Quests are listed in the Quest Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved the Wizard Activity meter to better represent the matchmaking possibilities.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎨VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✅ Improved the model and effects for the Statue Objective.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Visually increased the size of Sol’phish bullet hell projectiles.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved readability of the environment in the Frozen Ancients.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Added visual feedback when the Solar Pulse’s Size gets upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Correctly set the initial camera position to the spawning position of each player.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Made sure the player always faces the camera when (re)spawning.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Removed the default walking dust effect when moving around as a ghost.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved performance by optimizing the Health Potions.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved visual consistency between the different Ice Infusions.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed the Fire and Wildfire effects for the Phantom Blades (they were swapped).[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved visual feedback for Rocky Road spikes that deal Crit Damage (Augmentation).[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed some clipping issues on the models for Maggie, Sun Mage, Star Mage and Bryony.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed some render order issues with the lobby beam and the Starfish Mage outfit.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]⚖️BALANCING[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✅ Decreased the starter value for Pickup Distance, but increased the values for Enchantments to have more impactful skill progression.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Also increased Bryony’s pickup trait from [b]12%[/b] to [b]20%[/b] as a result.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Evasion Mend: decreased the heal from [b]25%[/b] to [b]20%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Vital Strike: decreased the heal from [b]0.4%[/b] to [b]0.3%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Steady Hand: increased Critical Chance from [b]20%[/b] to[b] 25%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✅ Attunement: increased Cast Speed from [b]15%[/b] to [b]20%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Increased the explosion radius of Spell Cores from [b]2 [/b]to [b]3[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Reduced the spawn distance for Spell Cores so they spawn relatively closer to the objective site.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved health scaling for Frostroot so the first one isn’t too hard and the last one isn’t too easy.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Decreased the health of Teethy Worms from [b]1,000[/b] to [b]900[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Increased the health of Baby Worms from [b]50[/b] to [b]125[/b], and increased their contact damage from [b]10[/b] to [b]30[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]⚙️STABILITY & BUGFIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🤝 Fixed an issue where sometimes bosses would seem to skip attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Fixed an issue in the Stat Menu where the incorrect Augmentation description would be displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Set the Framerate limit to 60 by default - you can still change it back to your preference.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed an issue where Mushrooms, Statues or Spell Cores would sometimes spawn outside of the map.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed an issue where Falling Stars and Necro Whirl would sometimes spawn outside of the map.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed an issue where insta-killing enemies would despawn them without playing any effects.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed an issue where Krog’wa’s health bar would sometimes show in a staggered state.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed an issue where Falling Stars would sometimes fall in an obstacle.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Fixed an issue where the mission would end in failure if a client lost connection while loading.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]✋ACCESSIBILITY[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✅ Implemented a slider for Spell Visibility, so players can increase the transparency of their Spells. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]🎉Some honorable mentions[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Gamescom[/b] was crazy! So many people came to check out the game - thank you all for the love 💖[/p][/*][*][p]We recently hired [b]Maria [/b]as our marketing lead! 🎉[/p][/*][*][p]On September 16th, The Spell Brigade turned [b]1 year old[/b]! 🥳[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/5a7d4959b6efa13dd529be14003f94f8e7c1cc42.png"][/img]  [/p][h3][b]⌛What’s next?[/b][/h3][list][*][p align="justify"]The [b]roadmap[/b] has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Update 13 is planned for [b]October 22nd[/b], just in time for the spooky season![/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]In the meantime, we’re getting ready for [b]1.0[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy the update, and see ya soon![/p][p][/p][p]BOLT BLASTER OUT [/p]

notes.title: The Spell Brigade is ending Native Linux support due to multiple issues
notes.notes:
You'll still be able to play The Spell Brigade with Valve's Proton, but the Native Linux version is no longer going to be supported or updated.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/09/the-spell-brigade-is-ending-native-linux-support-due-to-multiple-issues/

notes.title: News for Linux Players
notes.notes: [p][b]Linux players, just a quick heads-up before Update 12 drops on Sept 24:[/b][/p][p]We’re moving away from the native Linux build, but you can keep playing without interruption. All your progress will carry over to the Windows build under Proton, so you can continue where you left off and enjoy the latest updates.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re making this change for several reasons: [/p][list][*][p]Persistent visual bugs on NVIDIA cards on Linux, which are resolved by switching to Proton[/p][/*][*][p]Technical changes to the game’s netcode that prevent full compatibility with a native Linux build[/p][/*][*][p]Certain Linux-specific bugs, such as issues with screen resolutions and refresh rates[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] Native Linux build support will end with our next update on September 24th.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks for your understanding and continuous support![/b][/p][p][/p][p]BOLT BLASTER OUT [/p]

notes.title: 🧙 EA UPDATE 11 - THE BLOATED ONE
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/9d942ba9a4ddea2eac737e936c902b2c05d4a1eb.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re hyped to see what you guys think of this one! The 11th Update is here! Here’s a quick rundown:[/p][h3][b]🐸New Boss🐸[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdCP_VVrIQY5M4ax-u5SizDc-TuN6j8EbdBpXc5Sw4FUl9Q18Y09QXprCNAbUdmCSTVI78saPxt6Fhlp9t1XDTBCEBWmVJHXq3B7Hfz-MxERVdUkUgYMyfAF1fZrMUDLGGO2uphhw?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"][/img][/p][p]Meet [b]Krog’wa, the Bloated One[/b]. She has a bunch of cool moves, but I will not spoil them here. You will have to discover them yourself! You can encounter her in any of the realms, as she appears randomly (though you will have to have beaten Sol’phish once to unlock her).[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe-TBJxx25q6PkZ2B0Wkb36oalkhw5hhmqKOaOkdHac4CYHMbwY4NU_2RL412xMIzDZw-SGaiQ3SB7a4HeaFTnJZZpH4WxNM4KaHmd14Ic8UlgmytoVgdNDDr-vH7WQs_rGwHZAMw?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"][/img][/p][h3][b]🦑More Sol’phish Improvements🦑[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXft0z-iemETcfbD2ck8bN410fsBsTNWtr3WbQNa8pDLHWFbEOc51xjtnYy4UHswptlEe0AkyPBorNIBlOO2Fz17bLopt_HAK3S7XTEpYVbGFJGGZwbA5kkYF3UpowvOXKYzVJV_Bw?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"][/img][/p][p]Since Krog’wa’s move set is quite expansive compared to that of Sol’phish, we figured we needed to take it up a notch so they are more equally matched. Therefore, we gave Sol’phish [b]two new attacks[/b] (one of which you see here), as well as some variations, and different behaviors for each phase.[/p][h3][b]🎺New Wizard🎺[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc6MVebcsJ5Qjy4bzZRDfQ1x0pl__DuU_Di1-s-PKqo6U8QKRo2uXG8hw_bjjYYo2mVwtii_H0mZjTZ9ayEPxsAdBpZK0D5Uv7yoeWHBeMMG9ylxVx-2pv6xlYWa0yTzLz8UcJigg?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"][/img][/p][p]Meet [b]Pipwick[/b]! This fellow marches to the beat, with an army of unhinged impish creatures at his side! He uses his flute mask to cast spells, though his symphonic conventions are deemed somewhat… random.[/p][h3][b]💪Some more Augmentations💪[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXejV5qZ4qiTmvalaFLXzX23BxVQlEX77w-ehRyvd17T4ECeJyasliHVmcJu7Erlo_tOlB2LtFDvFrFhD4vLZzIr5I6W3o9V2Yc2yE6Ij1uzr855qhDph6vALjbZ6nLUhGQdpb3R?key=qjKRP685qRt8RF_GEGP04Q"][/img][/p][p]With all the new spells being added these last few updates, we occasionally take a look at some of the older ones to see what we can do to keep them up to par. For this update, we gave both the [b]Moonerang [/b]and[b] Solar Pulse[/b] a brand new augmentation, and have also reworked one for the [b]Rocky Road[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]Check out the patch notes below for more details. We hope you’ll enjoy this one![/p][p][/p][h2][b]PATCH NOTES – 0.11.0.4763 (02-07-25)[/b][/h2][h3][b]✨NEW✨[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🐸 A new Boss: [b]Krog’wa, the Bloated One[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🧙 A new Wizard: [b]Pipwick[/b][/p][/*][*][p]👕 2 new Outfits: [b]Dragon Tamer Pipwick[/b] & [b]Pipwick the Tune Tinkerer[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✨ A new Spell: [b]Impish Havoc[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🌙 [/b]A new Augmentation for [b]Moonerang[/b]: upon return, Moonerangs make an additional pass in the opposite direction[/p][/*][*][p][b]☀️ [/b]A new Augmentation for [b]Solar Pulse[/b]: deals more Damage towards its center[/p][/*][*][p]💀 Replaced the Flesh Crab variants with slightly more interesting grunts. Meet the [b]Crabling[/b], [b]Tripod [/b]and [b]Snipjaw[/b]![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🕹️GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS🕹️[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✅ [b]Sol’phish, the Long One[/b] now has 3 phases, each with their own move set.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Added various bullet hell attacks for Sol’phish, the Long One, that change between phases.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Added a homing projectile attack for Sol’phish, the Long One, that changes between phases.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Made the “More Damage towards the end” Augmentation for the [b]Rocky Road[/b] stackable.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Updated the Cooldown stat to [b]Cast Speed[/b] so it can count upwards like other stats (and be less confusing).[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Made sure that when leveling up, general stat upgrades that are irrelevant to currently equipped spells are no longer offered.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Added different [b]Stampeder [/b]configurations for each Threat Level.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Added different [b]Swarmling[/b] configurations for each Threat Level.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎨VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS🎨[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✅ Improved the Boss spawn sequence by making sure a Boss always looks towards the camera when spawning.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Visually updated the health bars for Bosses so they better visualize the newly implemented phases.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Added a delay effect to Boss health bars to improve feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed a UI issue where the Boss health bar would inaccurately show parts of the staggered state.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed a UI issue where the Progress Bar would add double icons when a Boss spawned.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved some animations for the Gnasher.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Gave Ghost Players a bit of offset so they don’t spawn inside their Revive Crystal when they die.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Updated the UI for the Spell Slots and their Infusions.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed a UI issue where sometimes selection feedback was visible while nothing was selected.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Fixed a UI issue when completing a Quest without a reward.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Removed the confusing default “Energy” element from the spell stats menu for spells that have no infusions.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Made sure the cursor doesn’t reset its position to the center of the screen when switching between keyboard, mouse and controller inputs.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Fixed a visual issue where the North Star outfit for the Star Mage would have some weird artifacting.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]⚖️BALANCING⚖️[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✅ Slightly increased the amount of XP needed to level up, per player in the party.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Slightly increased the general spawn frequency of enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Decreased the Damage of the Explode at End Augmentation for Falling Stars and Aurora Wings.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Tweaked some Spells so they’re better balanced throughout the whole run:[/p][list][*][p]Decreased Cast Speed of the [b]Astral Orbs[/b], but increased Damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Cast Speed of the [b]Solar Pulse[/b], but increased the Damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Damage of the [b]Aurora Wings[/b], but increased Cast Speed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]⚙️STABILITY & BUGFIXES⚙️[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🤝 Fixed an issue where Sol’phish would sometimes push players out of the map during its death animation.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed an issue where enemy spawning didn’t always take the amount of players into account.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Fixed an issue where some spells were able to target enemies through obstacles.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed an issue where Plasma spell bounces would apply triple the intended amount of Burn Damage.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Fixed an issue where the Moonerang’s Linger at Furthest Point Augmentation would scale incorrectly, resulting in dealing less Damage than intended.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed an issue where Rocky Road Augmentations would only activate after adding an Infusion.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed an issue where Swarmlings would disappear on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Fixed an issue where Vengeful Sprout would not target some enemies that appeared in range.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Fixed an issue where controller and keyboard menu navigation would lose focus after a mouse click.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Fixed an issue where the wrong pop-up was shown when a Host terminated the session.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]✋ACCESSIBILITY✋[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🤝 Added a setting that allows players to play with mouse only.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Made the Pause Menu accessible by mouse (middle mouse button).[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Made tooltips in the Level Up menus accessible by mouse (right click on an Upgrade Card).[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Made the Invite Friend prompt in the Lobby clickable.[/p][/*][/list][p]🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback[/p][p][/p][p]Update 12 is planned for[b] September 24th[/b]. A bit longer than usual, but it’s a big one. And the team also has some well-earned vacation days to spend, not to mention that one of us has a baby on the way! Oh, and we’re also attending Gamescom, so we’re not exactly sitting on our hands. But more on that soon![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the Summer Sales, stay cool, and see you guys soon![/p][p][/p][p]BOLT BLASTER OUT[/p][p]

notes.title: 🧙 EA UPDATE 10 - FROM THE DEAD
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/05953900e8769713f222b339762067fbbb42c0da.png[/img]

Brace yourselves, Update 10 has arrived! We've been hard at work on the game, trying to incorporate as much of your feedback as possible every step of the way. Therefore, we have been busy developing features for both this update and future updates. Nevertheless, this update has a lot of improvements, some reworks, and some new stuff as well. Catch the highlights below, or scroll down for the patch notes!

[h3][b]🪽 New Revive System 🪽[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/988262775fd8ee9cf648d029c6af92b095f51ba1.gif[/img]
We’ve reworked the [b]Revive System[/b] for multiplayer, so you’ll never sit on the sidelines again! Now, if you die, you become a [b]ghost[/b]! As a ghost, you can wander around the map and still collect XP orbs to help your team level up. We’ve also improved much of the feedback so players will be quicker to respond to teammates in need of assistance.

[h3][b]📊 New & Improved Stat Menus 📊[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/7b343c4562637d79bfa1a5fa014a763bebea8713.gif[/img]
This has been one of our most requested features, so we’re excited to share our new [b]Stat Menus[/b]! Aside from your Player Stats, you can now also access the stats of each of your Spells, as well as view the Relics you collected. You can now also access your performance (kills, objectives, etc.) during the current mission at any time.

[h3][b]🦇 New Wizard 🦇[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/d662cc809565d0c54a0dc6b6987bfc5893ecc58e.gif[/img]
The Spell Brigade’s most recent addition to the roster is quite an ominous fellow. [b]Balthazar [/b]stalks the mission fields with his melee-focused [b]Talon Slash[/b]. He also specializes in Lifesteal and has the unique ability to revive teammates from beyond the grave.

[h3][b]🤔 What’s Next? 🤔[/b][/h3]
As you know, we put a lot of effort into staying up-to-date on player feedback so we can always deliver on what our players want the most. That being said, being the small team that we are, some of this content, like [b]new Worlds[/b] or [b]Bosses[/b], takes a long time to design, implement, and iterate on.

Needless to say, trying to find the right balance between short and long-term development has proved a bit of a challenge. Because we DO want to keep giving you new stuff to check out regularly, and some of these things just take longer than a month to get right.

So if you’re wondering where the promised new world and bosses are, there’s your answer. We’re working on them. Wizards and Spells are just easier to add within shorter releases. But do not worry, they are coming soon! To summarize, here’s a quick rundown of the bigger things we’re currently working on:

☠️ [b]a new Boss[/b]
🌎 [b]a new World[/b]
👻 [b]new Enemies[/b]
🎯 [b]new Objectives[/b]
🌐 [b]Matchmaking improvements[/b]
🤝 [b]Many more community requested improvements[/b]

That’s all for now! Check out the patch notes for Update 10 below:

[h2][b]PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.10.0.4012 (21-05-25)[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]✨NEW✨[/b][/h3]
🪽 New [b]Revive [/b]system featuring [b]Ghost Wizards[/b]!
📊 New [b]Stat Menus[/b] for Spells, Relics & Missions.
🧙 A new Wizard: [b]Balthazar[/b]
👕 2 new Outfits: [spoiler][b]Nightshift Balthazar[/b] & [b]Emperor Balthazar[/b][/spoiler]
🦇 A new Spell: [b]Talon Slash[/b]
🌱 A [b]new Augmentation for Vengeful Sprout[/b]: Each Plant increases Damage and Size by 4% with every attack

[h3][b]🕹️GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS🕹️[/b][/h3]
🤝 Added the ability to access the pause menu while choosing items or waiting for items to be chosen.
🤝 Made sure all players receive rewards when they get disconnected or leave a match.
✅ Corrupted enemies do extra attacks when they have been overcorrupted.
🤝 Changed the store timer to only start when someone has picked the first item.

[h3][b]🎨VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS🎨[/b][/h3]
✅ Added a visual effect when corrupted enemies do an attack, and added a unique damage number visualization.
✅ Tweaked the sizes of various wizards so they're more consistent. Fixed some visual bugs/jitter in the idle animations of some wizards.
✅ Improved the lightning effects for the Arcane Broadsword.
✅ Added a unique model for the Teethy Worm’s offspring.

[h3][b]⚖️BALANCING⚖️[/b][/h3]
✅ Slightly reduced the damage of Aurora Wings for each extra target Augmentation.
🤝 Reduced the amount of HP added to enemies per Endless cycle.
✅ Added player position prediction to compensate for networking lag.
✅ Corrupted enemies attack 60% faster.
✅ Corrupted enemies are no longer corrupted after their last corruption attack.
🤝 Slightly increased gold rewards for longer runs.
🤝 Lowered the Gold threshold for unlocking the Infusion and New Spells Reroll button from 50,000 to 35,000.

[h3][b]⚙️STABILITY & BUGFIXES⚙️[/b][/h3]
✅ Fixed an issue where players had to cancel matchmaking twice.
🤝 Fixed several matchmaking problems.
🤝 Fixed an issue where damage numbers would reach an integer overflow.
🤝 Fixed an issue where all respawn beams were big when the host was playing with Campanelli.
🤝 Fixed an issue where corrupted enemies copied the Critical Hit Chance and Critical Damage from the player that corrupted it; instead, they now have a fixed 10% Critical Hit Chance and 150% Critical Damage.
✅ Fixed a shader issue that would lead to a game crash.
✅ Fixed an issue where duplicate resolutions were added to the settings, locking the player.
✅ Changed the description of the Rocky Road spell so it's more accurate.
🤝 Updated the description for healing Augmentations that only heal teammates (and not the caster).
✅ Fixed an issue where the death splash of an enemy killed by a corrupted enemy was in the opposite direction.
✅ Fixed an issue where enemies couldn't spawn fast enough after killing a lot of enemies.

[h3][b]✋ACCESSIBILITY ✋[/b][/h3]
🤝 Implemented a setting to enable/disable damage numbers.

🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback

Enjoy the update! We’ll be hard at work on Update 11, which will be released on July 2nd. You can expect some of the things we mentioned above. 🤫

BOLT BLASTER OUT

notes.title: 🧙 EA UPDATE 9 - DARK DEVOTION
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/377b2843787e0bbba1a4a9dec23d33a7871ca245.png[/img]

Our ninth early access update called [b]Dark Devotion[/b] is now available! Check out the highlights below, or scroll to the bottom for the patch notes.

[h3][b]🌚Dark Element🌚[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/fc96e9993b9f863ea3ae1fd8d18dd71a0857d0e6.gif[/img]
We’re very excited to share this [b]fifth element![/b] You can now infuse your Spells with this Dark new element, which will allow you to corrupt enemies so they turn to your side. Oh, and you can also combine this element with the others, creating many new combos.

[h3][b]🌱Another Wizard🌱[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/284ad0117e314be892666b709c37d23e4b4f3b1c.gif[/img]
The Spell Brigade adds yet another Wizard! [b]Bryony[/b] is a potion specialist/herb enthusiast, who is also half plant. Her signature Spell is called [b]Vengeful Sprout[/b], which grows giant plants that attack any enemy within range.

[h3][b]💀3 new Enemies💀[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/7bade75ffbdb0d5fa8ecae9c7e089dedc7d37432.gif[/img]
We have added a new enemy to each of the 3 Realms. The Verdant Meadows are being patrolled by hordes of ravenous [b]Stampeders[/b], the Frozen Ancients are being stalked by the eerie [b]Frostroot[/b] and the Pyrestorm Pit is now home to many flocks of migrating [b]Swarmlings[/b]. 

[h3][b]📜5 new Relics📜[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/34e272686344cf60a0d8755b6eb8e1b65ef75104.gif[/img]
Finally, we have added 5 brand new Relics, and we have also rebalanced/reworked some old ones. Each new Relic can be unlocked by completing the right Quest.

✅ [b]Healthy Growth[/b]: You regain [b]10% of your Max HP[/b] every time you Level Up.

✅ Added status effect visualizers to enemies for Acid, Frostbite (Acid + Ice) and Blight (Acid + Dark).
✅ Added a despawn effect to the Spitter’s projectiles.

notes.title: 🧙‍♂️ Early Access - Update 0.7.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/42b36355d79373de61686f9c750e8b2a2935b476.png[/img]

0.7 is here! We know this one features some highly requested and anticipated features so let’s just get down to it immediately:

[h3][b]👻INTRODUCING NEW ENEMIES[/b][/h3]
We've added 2 new enemies. Our questionable naming skills aside, behold...

[b]THE SNEAKY BUG[/b]
Sneaky Bugs roam the Frozen Ancients, only running at you when your back’s turned to them (hence [i]“sneaky”[/i]).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/8c5e88be7590409c302ea6f0fd8851c39639f745.gif[/img]

[b]THE FLYING MANTA[/b]
Flying Mantas - get this - fly around the Pyrestorm Pit. They’ll draw on you quickly so beware! We’re also currently working on more Realm-specific enemies, but more on that later…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/8a4abb279d848f0d5aba18782fb05a7a7d0ce2f4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]📜INTRODUCING COVENANTS[/b][/h3]
The highly requested [b]Friendly Fire toggle[/b] and [b]Endless Mode[/b] have both been implemented in the form of Modifiers, which we’re calling Covenants. When selecting your Realm and Threat Level, you can now also activate any of the available Covenants to modify the rules of your run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/213ea2a1d3df849e715612a07dee2d49b685b265.gif[/img]

Activate Harmony Pact to disable Friendly Fire, meaning you can’t hurt yourself or your teammates, and they can’t either. Activate Eternal Bond to enable Endless Mode, allowing you to keep playing after defeating Sol’phish, and starting a new cycle.

We plan to add more Covenants in the future, so we’re very excited to see what this brings to the game. Obviously, balancing an endless experience is very challenging, and we will be constantly improving this mode throughout Early Access to get it just right.

[h3][b]🌐MATCHMAKING IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3]
While these new features add a lot of value to the game, we quickly realized that this would also impact the matchmaking, as more choices for your run will also create more scattering of lobbies, making it potentially harder to match with the right players. And while our numbers are definitely growing, our player base is not THAT big to have many matches for each particular run choice.

That’s why we took some more time to not only improve the matchmaking process technically, but also give players some more options when trying to find players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/c5fdc07c4f27b90f2eed7426b7d52f7b3240d86a.gif[/img]

By accessing the Matchmaking Options, you can now choose to prioritize your own run choices, or match with players in any run setup. We also added a meter for “Wizard Activity”, which essentially gives you a rough estimate of how easily you can find other players.

There are many more tiny fixes and improvements added, you can find those in the patch notes below:

[h3][b]PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.7.0.2018[/b][/h3]
[b]NEW[/b]
📜 A new Covenant: [b]Harmony Pact[/b] (disables Friendly Fire)
📜 A new Covenant: [b]Eternal Bond[/b] (enables Endless Mode) 
👻 A new Enemy: [b]Sneaky Bug[/b]
👻 A new Enemy: [b]Flying Manta[/b]
🌐 Added a menu for Matchmaking Preferences.

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
🤝 Added new player icons that match the player’s equipped Outfit for each Wizard.
✅ Added some very cool trees to the environment of the Verdant Meadows.
🤝 Improved Enemy syncing between clients.
✅ Made Enemy Statues invulnerable to lava in the Pyrestorm Pit.
✅ Optimized texture resolutions for better performance.
✅ Improved the UI for Realm, Threat Level and Covenant selection.
✅ Improved UI readability by adding a blur effect where necessary.
🤝 Added a fancy Roadmap button to the Start Menu.
🤝 Removed time limit for Matchmaking.
✅ Improved Matchmaking by giving priority to fuller Lobbies when searching for Players.

[b]BALANCING[/b]
🤝 Magic Missile: increased Range and Range Upgrades with [b]10%[/b].
🤝 Aether Beam: increased DPS boost to [b]20%[/b] when adding additional projectiles by.
✅ Aether Beam: rebalanced the dividing of Damage over multiple Beams, so the correct amount of Damage is always dealt.
✅ Sulfur Geysers: increased Damage and increased the Cooldown by [b]30%[/b].
✅ Changed application of Speed Upgrade logic so it’s only applied once. Doubled values for Move Speed increases for standard Upgrades, Relics, Enchantments and Wizard stats to adjust for this fix.

[b]STABILITY[/b]
🤝 Fixed an issue where collected Funghi wouldn’t count towards Quest progress for clients.
⚙️ Fixed an issue where Relics couldn’t be picked up immediately.
🤝 Fixed an issue where Sol’phish and the Golden Flesh Crab would spawn outside of the map in the Pyrestorm Pit.
⚙️ Fixed an issue where projectiles would sometimes despawn on the world’s 0 position.
⚙️ Fixed an issue on the Steam Deck where button prompts weren’t shown accurately.
🤝 Fixed an issue where the Falling Star’s Explosion Augmentation would clip through other effects.
⚙️ Fixed an issue where the Main Menu’s Leave button would still be interactable while in the Loading screen, resulting in the game breaking.
🤝 Fixed an issue where some Fire Damage ticks were skipped on high Fire Rates.

🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback


Enjoy the update! We’ve also joined the Autumn Sales and gave the game a 20% discount, so if there’s ever a time to try it out with your friends, it’s now.

notes.title: FAQ - Spell Upgrades
notes.notes:
[b]ATTENTION BRIGADEERS![/b] The Spell Brigade releases in [b]1 DAY![/b] AAAAAAAAAAAAA

As part of our countdown to release, we’ve released a 5-part FAQ series featuring some much asked about topics regarding the game. You can check out our last 4 posts, where we delved into our [i]co-op matchmaking, meta progression, friendly fire[/i] and[i] revive system[/i]. For our final one, we’re going over all the different kinds of ✨[b]SPELL UPGRADES[/b]✨  you can find in our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/cd7af770c87946bc47f748992622b817f72b048f.gif[/img]

[h3][b]STANDARD UPGRADES[/b][/h3]
While on a mission, you will encounter many different upgrades to choose from and further customize your build. You will get upgrades mostly from [b]leveling up[/b]. By collecting orbs you find from killed enemies and completed objectives, you increase your level. This level is shared among the whole team, so whenever that XP bar fills up, everyone in the team gets one. You get to choose between 3 upgrades, which include things like increasing your Move Speed or Max Health, but also Spell-specific upgrades that increase things like their Cooldown or Damage. Each upgrade is either Common, Rare, Epic, or Legendary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/2d85872088b8e5c0c73002a747e7727227c093d4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]NEW SPELLS[/b][/h3]
When you reach certain levels, you will get to choose a [b]new Spell[/b] to add to your attacks. You can get up to 4 Spells at the same time. We have a limited number of Spells at the moment, but we’ll definitely be expanding on these during Early Access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/daf3bf2e13348ca199719f6740c56c281fc493db.gif[/img]

[h3][b]RELICS[/b][/h3]
Throughout your Missions, you will occasionally find [b]a chest[/b] that holds something within. Find and break these open so you can collect these Relics and use their unique effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/0b6c53ad02a1e39a9b4e05809e8482eae69b878e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]INFUSIONS[/b][/h3]
When leveling up, you’ll notice that the Spell-specific upgrades have a weird orb meter at the bottom. If you upgrade your Spell enough times, you will reach the big ones on the meter, allowing you to infuse that Spell with an element. You can do this [b]up to 2 times[/b], making all kinds of cool combinations. We have 4 elements at the moment and are planning to add more, so the possibilities will be growing exponentially.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/96e030bfbf18f75e4ad3549aa13dc2cdeb3cff81.gif[/img]

[h3][b]AUGMENTATIONS[/b][/h3]
[b]Complete objectives[/b] and you will be rewarded with a special type of upgrade. Augmentations are very specific upgrades for your Spells that give them a unique effect that really changes up the way they work. We won’t spoil them here, but trust us when we say that completing your objectives and getting these upgrades is definitely worth it.

Keep in mind that both the amount and kinds of upgrades are something that we plan to expand on during Early Access, so there will be many more upgrades in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/bd2a1a20ae2c198a21a5a8bdd32ee8dcf4b9912e.gif[/img]

That’s it! Now that you have read all 5 parts, you have all the knowledge needed to become part of the Spell Brigade! And just in time, too! Tune in tomorrow as we’ll be [b]live streaming[/b] the game to celebrate the launch. In the meantime, if you haven’t already, you can:

notes.title: FAQ - Dying & Reviving
notes.notes:
[b]ATTENTION BRIGADEERS![/b] The Spell Brigade releases in [b]2 DAYS![/b]

As part of our countdown to release, we’re releasing a 5-part FAQ series, featuring some much asked about topics regarding the game. You can check out our last 3 posts which tackled our [i]co-op matchmaking, meta progression[/i] and [i]friendly fire[/i]. Now, let’s break down our [b]REVIVE SYSTEM[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/197339b94b3c1e78797b89c81bcf3bdf8fdb6f2c.gif[/img]

As we like to mention, dying and coming back is a big part of our game, more so than your regular roguelite even! Because aside from the usual “die, unlock upgrades, try again” shtick, our game features a revive system inspired by some of our favorite co-op games. 

[h2][b]MEMENTO MORI
[/b][/h2]So, what happens when we die? Who can say, really? As for our wizards here though, when they take a hit too many, they explode, leaving nothing behind but a bright crystal. It is up to another member of the Spell Brigade to charge up this crystal so their fallen teammate can beam back into action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/c71f4b16761cca4e54bd8c5bc4f1c617d9440e2c.gif[/img]

Performing this sacred ritual is no easy feat, and can only be done with the use of a Revive Token. Each wizard starts with 2. By upgrading one of your Enchantments, you can start with more. In a team though, these Revive Tokens are shared. So a team of 4 wizards would start out with 8 Revive Tokens, which can be spent on whoever needs them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/c9b792e4f1f462a4cda64e662aa9691e986b1c8b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]BACK WITH A BANG
[/b][/h2]When a wizard is successfully revived, they can slightly adjust their position before beaming back into the battlefield, dealing an enormous amount of damage to anything within range. Many wizards find strategic value in this move, and sometimes die on purpose so they can use this powerful ability to their advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/213a1418e1c5903b51b992d4f3cfd760fa25c41e.gif[/img]

When the team is out of Revive Tokens, a new one is always slowly generated. This takes time however, so only count on this as a last resort. Because when there are no more Revive Tokens, and the last wizard standing dies, the mission has failed, and the wizards are forced to return to their base, fleeing to fight another day.

Tune in tomorrow for a final FAQ, where we go over the different types of Spell upgrades. We hope you found these posts interesting and are stoked to try out the game! Don’t forget to:

[b]ATTENTION BRIGADEERS![/b] The Spell Brigade releases in [b]3 DAYS![/b]

As part of our countdown to release, we’re releasing a 5-part FAQ series, featuring some much asked about topics regarding the game. So far we’ve tackled our co-op and meta progression. Today, let’s talk 🔥[b]FRIENDLY FIRE[/b]🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/a2564c57e11ea63b2b8382ccdd4274f9e619a150.gif[/img]

From the start, the idea behind The Spell Brigade was to combine the popular survivors-like mechanics from games like [i]Vampire Survivors, Death Must Die, Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor[/i], and so on, with our love for chaotic co-op gameplay. We took inspiration from games like [i]Magicka[/i] and the recent [i]Helldivers 2[/i] to create something that can challenge even the closest of friendships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/259c2b698aae0246961123d7d52b07835215aa07.gif[/img]

Of course, the main difference between those games and ours, is that the auto-fire and uncontrollable aim crank the insanity up to eleven when trying to survive as a team. Not only are you constantly dodging enemies, but also your friends! It’s a special type of risk-reward that we’re constantly having to iterate on, making this the perfect mechanic to perfect during Early Access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/7544ae6a02ab018174898f51ad2020798e167743.gif[/img]

Every wizard is susceptible to damage from any source. Wizards take gradually less damage from other wizards than from enemies (perhaps they have learned to shield themselves somewhat from magical abilities?), but taking your friend’s Astral Orb to the face still has consequences! However, we’re introducing some Augmentations that convert this friendly fire into healing. Combined with our team-based objectives, players can find benefit in sticking together. Aside from the comradery and silly accidents, of course. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/701b843655dff8b003d375320100ae4326fd63ae.gif[/img]

And after all, dying isn’t that permanent in our game. Coming back with a blast is a big part of the fun. But more on that tomorrow! Our 4th post will be all about our Revive system, so stay tuned. For now, you can:

notes.title: FAQ - Meta Progression
notes.notes:
[b]ATTENTION BRIGADEERS![/b] The Spell Brigade releases in [b]4 DAYS![/b]

As part of our countdown to release, we’re releasing a 5-part FAQ series, featuring some much asked about topics regarding the game. Yesterday we shared some info on the workings of our co-op matchmaking system. Today is all about our [i][b]Player Progression[/b][/i].

We took inspiration from other survivors like [i]Vampire Survivors[/i] and [i]Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor[/i] to create a simple but effective progression system. Everything is unlocked the same way, by completing [b]Quests[/b]. 

[h2][b]QUESTS[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/37a3a8cd241f7f0d6b07153c3030cd00e0f0edf6.gif[/img]
Quests are challenges that are tracked over multiple runs. These include tasks like [i]Equip X Spells, Level Up X times, Revive X teammates[/i], but also more specific ones, like infusing a specific Element to a specific Spell or performing a particular action with one of the Wizards. Each completed Quest grants you a reward. These are new Wizards, new Enchantments, new Realms, and more. If you complete a Quest mid-run, that content can already become available in that run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/8fe8f4a107a0e44e6b2ea16d5e02416dd2cc261e.gif[/img]

[h2][b]ENCHANTMENTS[/b][/h2]
As the missions get tougher, your Wizards can grow stronger! Enchantments are permanent stat increases that you can purchase with Gold you earn on missions. There are 3 Tiers, each containing 5 Enchantments that can be upgraded multiple times (each Tier is unlocked through completing a Quest).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/faa11896f55b0d0af5e50820ae517e53baf55129.gif[/img]
You can upgrade your Enchantments in whatever order you like, and you can also refund them. This resets all your Enchantments back to 0 and returns all the Gold spent to you.

[h2][b]WIZARDS[/b][/h2]
You start the game with good old Reginald as the only available Wizard. By completing Quests, you unlock new ones. Each Wizard has a different starting Spell, as well as some stat buffs. There are [b]8[/b] playable Wizards in total (for now), and a selection of unlockable [b]Outfits[/b] for each one as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/c55be8cae4a7db37a4ab22bbb995181bb606001e.gif[/img]

[h2][b]MISSIONS[/b][/h2]
For your Mission ([i]run[/i]), you can select which Realm ([i]world[/i]) and Threat Level ([i]difficulty[/i]) to survive in. There are 3 of each, which are also unlocked by completing Quests. Each Realm has some unique environmental hazards. The Threat Levels range from Moderate to Severe to Hardcore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/caabc325c2534bab008ce488d2149a5568d3d0b9.gif[/img]

That’s a quick rundown of everything our Player Progression has to offer on Early Access release. Of course, this is only the beginning. We plan to add and improve, partly by the feedback and suggestions from you!

Tomorrow, we tackle one of our most talked-about mechanics: Friendly Fire! We’ll go over the inner workings and the design choices we made during development.

Most of the content will be accessible in both single and multiplayer, but some items and upgrades are specifically designed to create meaningful co-op moments. Since those would not do much for a single player, we’ve excluded them from the pool when playing alone.

notes.title: 🔥The new world is here! (and it's hot)
notes.notes:
[b]FULL STEAM AHEAD![/b] This dev train is not slowing down! We have another dev log for you with some cool new things to share.

[h2][b]WORLD 3[/b][/h2]
We’ll get right to the good stuff. Our third world is almost done! It’s called the [i]Scorched Abyss[/i] (for now), and it has some new environmental hazards that you’ll have to watch out for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/b0da86895b5708f0b0da0f256c29e90e76f605e5.gif[/img]

Firstly, there are some nasty lava pits all over the map that slowly change their shape. Walking over them will damage you (duh), so beware.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/03c75a3ba7c7775ee5cbf1f2c46bb40ef809a633.gif[/img]

This world also introduces [b]tornadoes[/b]! They move all over the map, damaging any player or enemy that gets too close. As the run progresses, more tornadoes will start to appear, so better hold onto your hats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/eff03db41290bedd56710f90c96668f7d646e759.png[/img]

[h2][b]OUTFITS[/b][/h2]
We’ve also been putting a lot of work into our [b]UI and meta progression[/b], so we’re excited to share some of that stuff as well! As you know, this is a co-op game. And what good co-op game doesn’t have cool skins to show off to your teammates? Each wizard will have 2 additional skins on release, which you can unlock by completing [b]Quests[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/ac245d91885ae43a3615e27e45e0736fca275eb8.gif[/img]

[h2][b]QUESTS[/b][/h2]
That brings us to the next menu! Quests are challenges that you can complete throughout your runs to unlock additional content. We have about 40 of them at the moment, unlocking new Realms, Wizards, Outfits, Enchantments, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/f4243cac1a03dabc806790d2d39c047a1f90d1f1.gif[/img]

[h2][b]ENCHANTMENTS[/b][/h2]
Talking about Enchantments, these are permanent upgrades that you can unlock by spending the Gold you earn on your runs. These upgrades count for all your Wizards (and yes, we’ve already made a respec button, no worries).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/3ea75300c3e4ab3a1028945bf850bf094f34449e.gif[/img]

[h2][b]RELICS[/b][/h2]
Lastly, we’ve added a new type of upgrade as well. They’re called Relics. Players can look for chests throughout the map and destroy them to reveal a scroll. When picked up, every player will be able to choose a passive effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/232746dea1ab70bffdbf67ff0b7268699f2168ca.gif[/img]

We hope you liked what you saw! If you have any questions about the demo or some cool ideas to share, [b]join our discord![/b] We still post dev stuff daily and are starting to gather quite a community of people who will help you out, so don’t be shy!

https://discord.gg/8qZ2zd22t6 

That’s it!

BOLT BLASTER OUT

notes.title: So you wanted more upgrades...
notes.notes:
In between all the chaos of managing a Closed Beta, updating a Demo and attending Tiny Teams, we noticed that it’s been some time since we did another dev update, so let’s go! 

A ton has happened, so we’ll go over the highlights:

[h2][b]WORLD 1[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/35ab4050de4b3f21b80f8369fe865e55ca26bd73.gif[/img]

With all the cool additions we’ve done to the Frozen Ancients, we figured the Verdant Meadows were also due for an update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/7f734d201b0bff57e078e5ca749bf89cfad52d0e.gif[/img]

We have reworked the level design, and added some new features. Like this road for instance, which you can use to move a bit faster (no more pesky grasslands to slow you down). Visuals are still in progress, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/411fdc48fed705ebdf4ba4dce94904f1927803b6.gif[/img]

[h2][b]WIZARDS[/b][/h2]
We’ve also made the final 2 Wizards for release (more will follow), who shall yet remain unnamed. Here’s a teaser, featuring the other 2 Wizards we recently revealed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/052cb6982533fe698e5a4fa69bdd3c09839576b6.gif[/img]

[h2][b]NEW ENEMY[/b][/h2]
New heroes means new enemies, so we’ve made another one that might really change up the battlefield. This little guy runs around and heals other enemies, so prioritizing them might be a smart plan. They mostly stay in the back of a horde though, so you’ll have to strategize with your fellow wizards to take ‘em down! Oh, and we don’t have a good name yet, so please share if you know one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/855bcf4e32a93e004a0a86a7605a95a3c1266cfb.gif[/img]

[h2][b]OBJECTIVES[/b][/h2]
We recently added some new Objectives to the demo, so you might have seen them all already. Nevertheless, we’ll go over them here. We’re still very much balancing these and improving the feedback, but their core concepts should stay the same.

[b]The Rift[/b] and [b]Sacrificial Ritual[/b] were already in the demo from the start. The new ones include a fleeing [b]Golden Crab[/b], which you must chase down and kill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/e5872af8efdab9b73f741773c8e903ef94c95112.gif[/img]

Another one is the [b]Bewitched Fungi[/b] objective. To successfully complete this one, all players must find a specific amount of mushrooms before the timer runs out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/b0319de2ecc872a92ff78f4a513bd38eff769385.gif[/img]

[h2][b]SPELL AUGMENTATIONS
[/b][/h2]And lastly, we’ve added a new type of Spell Upgrade to the game. You get these by completing the Objectives. They are called [b]Augmentations[/b], and they are more unique, more impactful upgrades, unique to your Spells. Some examples are making your projectiles split, fire in bursts, heal teammates or fire additional projectiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/eeb06c949f76a02465fd550f438b0c2a96129dec.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/17a2e1dfdd085c41482c1ddaf819e446f24115d6.gif[/img]

Some more specific examples are increasing the Rocky Road’s size over time, adding bounces to the Hex Bomb or making the Magic Missile explode at the end of its lifetime. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/1add8201915f08ec7ae898a3d15ab2178b530936.gif[/img]

We’ve added a small amount to the demo for you to try out, but we plan to make many more! For the release, you can expect each Spell to have about 3 of these. They are all combinable, and some of them can even be applied multiple times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/12216d27dcc796fa1cdf405d1b37521fe4afad82.gif[/img]

Ok, that was a big one! If you’re still here, we want to thank you for following this project! We hope these dev posts keep you excited for our game, as we get closer to the release! Our discord community has been growing quite a bit recently, so if you want to be part of the fun, come say hi! We even post development updates [b]DAILY [/b](holy moly)!

https://discord.gg/8qZ2zd22t6 

I think that’s it for now. Enjoy the summer, but not too much!

BOLT BLASTER OUT

[b]REGINALD SHADOWCLOAK
[/b]Reginald Shadowcloak has the Astral Orbs spell. This launches floating orbs in the direction of enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/c0905d2e2e40bbb9f43fa2d0176c1c80ce007627.gif[/img]

[b]MOON MAGE
[/b]Moon Mage has a very appropriately named spell called Moonerang, which is, well, a boomerang that travels through enemies and always returns to you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/da14ea55b4f778299f62e0a8c7dd57e4a7e852c3.gif[/img]

[b]SUN MAGE
[/b]Sun Mage possesses Solar Pulse, which generates a constant damage zone around you that hurts all nearby enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/ba623b88dcd1a82145de5b035e228124d65dd7f3.gif[/img]

[b]KEVIN THE KURSED
[/b]Kevin the Kursed has Necro Whirl. It also generates damage zones, but in random places on the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/81515a20c07b3fa805f6d945a511baed296df841.gif[/img]

There will, of course, be many, many spells in the future. Each spell can be upgraded to increase things like damage, fire rate, reload speed, and more. Upgrading a spell enough times will allow you to infuse it with an element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/5360d19974e9864fb7f1ca990057a75957422b4d.gif[/img]

This is where the fun begins. You can infuse a spell with an element up to 2 times, meaning you can have a spell that is half fire, half lightning, or maybe double lightning. So far, we have only 2 elements, but you can see the potential for so many cool combinations already. Imagine what we can create with 3, 4 or 5 elements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/39ddf48d6aa610bbfda022c81b8c5c187ab9bf16.gif[/img]

[b]DEMO FEEDBACK
[/b]Some people have already played the early version of the demo that’s live now and have given some great feedback. We’re very grateful, as this allows us to improve the demo for Next Fest. You can expect some patch notes this week, as we are fully focused on balancing, stabilizing, and optimizing the demo.

Some other things we’ve done:
[list]
[*] UI polish for the upgrade menu
[*] Localization for Chinese and Japanese (beta)
[*] Enemy effects like XP orbs and death explosions
[*] Lots of bug-fixing and balancing (more still on the way this week)
[/list]
Be sure to [b]WISHLIST [/b]and join our [url=https://discord.gg/8qZ2zd22t6 ][b]DISCORD[/b][/url] where we post development updates [b]DAILY (what?!)[/b].


That’s about it. Till next week!

BOLT BLASTER OUT
